description_en: Restarts a node in a PolarDB cluster
name: RestartDBNode

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster node.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the node IDs.

Nodes in serverless (AgileServerless) clusters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
集群节点ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/185342.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括节点ID。

不支持 Serverless（AgileServerless）类型集群的节点
parameters.name: db_node_id

parameters.help_en:
The earliest time to start the scheduled node restart task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
The start time must be within the next 72 hours. For example, if the current time is `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`, the allowed start time ranges from `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` to `2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`.
If this parameter is left empty, the node restart task is executed immediately by default
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行定时（即在目标时间段内执行）重启节点任务的最早时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
开始时间的取值范围为未来72小时内的任意时间点。例如当前时间为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`，此处允许填入的开始时间范围为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`~`2021-01-17T09:00:00Z`。
若该参数留空，默认立即执行重启节点任务
parameters.name: planned_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The latest time to start the scheduled task. Specify the time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC.
The latest time must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
If `PlannedStartTime` is specified but this parameter is not, the latest time to start the task defaults to 30 minutes after the start time. For example, if `PlannedStartTime` is set to `2021-01-14T09:00:00Z` and this parameter is left empty, the task will start no later than `2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`
parameters.help_zh:
开始执行目标定时任务的最晚时间。格式为`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC）。
最晚时间需晚于开始时间的30分钟或以上。
若设置了`PlannedStartTime`但未指定该参数，执行目标任务的最晚时间默认为`开始时间+30分钟`。例如当设置`PlannedStartTime`为`2021-01-14T09:00:00Z`且该参数留空时，目标任务最晚将于`2021-01-14T09:30:00Z`开始执行
parameters.name: planned_end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute the node restart task immediately or at a scheduled time. Valid values:

false (default): executes the task at a scheduled time.

true: executes the task immediately
parameters.help_zh:
立即执行或定时执行重启节点任务。取值范围如下：

false（默认）：定时执行

true：立即执行
parameters.name: from_time_service

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
parameters.name: region_id
